PRO red::getproperty, item, value, HELP = hlp, PRINT = prnt, PTR = ptr IF keyword_set(hlp) OR n_params() EQ 0 THEN BEGIN help, self, /obj, OUT = value ENDIF ELSE BEGIN IF keyword_set(ptr) THEN $ ok = execute('value = *self.'+item) $ ELSE $ ok = execute('value = self.'+item) ENDELSE IF keyword_set(prnt) OR n_params() LT 2 THEN $ print, value, FORMAT = "((a))" END
